verdict: The entire 16-dimensional SU(3)-fixed four-form space is classified exactly.  Its common 54/4125 projector-zero locus contains only the signed Kahler-square orbit; in particular, all eight non-diagonal Omega_3 wedge R4 directions are forced to zero by explicit real sum-of-squares relations.  This rules out a large additional symmetry class of disconnected branches, but arbitrary real four-forms need not be conjugate into this slice, so the corrected global orbit theorem and G3 remain open.
